description: This Kotlin source file defines an internal extension function for the Android build system, specifically to disable unnecessary Android instrumented tests when certain source directories are absent. It includes licensing information, package declaration, necessary imports, and the function implementation.

methods.name: disableUnnecessaryAndroidTests
methods.description: An extension function for LibraryAndroidComponentsExtension that disables androidTest tasks if the 'src/androidTest' directory does not exist in the project.
